Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between coaching and your done-for-you services?

Coaching is hands-on and educational. I install OpenClaw on YOUR machine, teach you how to use it, and build automations with you. Done-for-you means I handle everything remotely and you just see the results.

Do I need technical skills?

No. I handle all the technical setup. You just need to be able to use your computer and follow instructions. If you can use email and browse the web, you're qualified.

How long does setup take?

Initial OpenClaw installation takes 2-3 hours. Building your first automation takes another 2-3 hours. Most clients are fully operational within a week.

What if I want to cancel monthly support?

You can cancel anytime. Your OpenClaw installation and automations remain yours. You'll just lose access to updates, new features, and my support.

Can you work with my existing tools?

Absolutely. I integrate with Gmail, Slack, Notion, Airtable, Google Sheets, and 100+ other tools. If it has an API, we can probably connect it.
